annotations.title: Summarize audio: voice note or meeting recording to summary and action items

description: Summarize a voice note, meeting, call or podcast in one call: transcribes up to 60 minutes (MP3/WAV up to 25 MB; M4A, OGG or WebM up to 5 MB) by URL or upload, then returns a title, summary, key points, action items with owner and due date, open questions and the transcript, in the recording's language. Use for meeting notes, voicemail to CRM and call notes. Example: url=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/77/Tofino_pronunciation.mp3. Price $0.05/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

language.description: Spoken language code such as en, sv or de (default: detected)

transcript.description: false: leave the full transcript out of the answer (default true)

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the recording (MP3/WAV up to 25 MB and 60 minutes; M4A, OGG or WebM up to 5 MB); or POST the file itself (raw body, multipart `file` part, or base64 in JSON)

name: transcribe_summary
title: Summarize audio: voice note or meeting recording to summary and action items
